title: Supported platforms
statement: The system shall run on Linux on x86-64 and ARM64 processors, on bare-metal servers and virtual machines.
rationale: PO decision: Linux x86-64 and ARM64 on bare metal/VMs.

acceptance_criteria.text: Each release publishes server binaries for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64.
The full release test suite, including the Jepsen-style suite, passes on both linux/amd64 and linux/arm64.
A cluster mixing amd64 and arm64 nodes passes the transaction test suite.

notes: Open: minimum Linux kernel and glibc versions.
